jacket.method: Thin-plate grid sculpt, fixed source station, unchanged per-vertex camera depth; inferred hidden surfaces

contourRefinements.method: Residual adjustment of training contours only; held-out edge observations are never used as controls.

lightingModel: baked full diffuse + local probe specular; no duplicate live direct contribution
accuracy: Visible VR forms; estimated depth and dimensions. Nominal R03 mechanics is a separate representation.

gridDeformationValidation.test: Analytic grid-map Jacobian sampled at every sculpted surface vertex; tapered branch connections keep their seated ends.

mountingInterfaces.status: Compatible nominal load path retained; bedding inferred and seated on the existing digital bilge

solidNormalsValidation.method: Manifold edges and positive signed volume after deformation; evaluated source primitives are oriented outward before modifiers and diffuse baking.

visibilityValidation.method: First geometric ray hit from the fixed reference station; independent of two-sided preview shading.

nativeShadingNormalsValidation.method: Split normals derived from evaluated geometry, sharp edges at 38 degrees; all nondegenerate head/cover corner normals remain above their geometric tangent plane.

nativeTopologyValidation.scope: New left derivative only; coincident native vertices reconnected before UV unwrapping. Original R03 and right instance unchanged.

diffuseSampling.fineNormalMaps: excluded from low-frequency diffuse bake; retained for material and reflection rendering

probeEmitters.visibility: camera rays only during probe capture; excluded from diffuse bake and runtime geometry

irradiance.mode: full diffuse without albedo; direct + indirect; runtime direct lighting excluded

receiver.mode: linear attenuation of diffuse on existing near-floor receiver surfaces only

contours.method: Distances from manually identified visible photograph outline controls to the actual rendered silhouette; fixed original cube camera

contours.annotation: Manually traced visible contour controls, approximate pixel labels; not hidden surfaces

clearance.method: Nearest-surface samples along a vertical walking capsule at centers of already-walkable cells; conservative vertical spacing envelope
